conditional_control_flow.description: C120 Conditional Control Flow: Enforces that flow-altering statements are only used inside an IF/ELSE block

constant_assignment.description: C220 Single-assignment Constants: Enforces that constants (c-prefixed variables) are assigned only once

do_not_use_undocumented_functions.description: C430 Do Not Use Undocumented Functions: Reports calls to TurboIntegrator functions that are not officially documented or supported by IBM

docstring_region.description: D110 Docstring Region: Enforces a docstring region before executable code in the prolog

empty_block.description: C110 Empty Block: Flags IF/ELSEIF/ELSE/WHILE blocks that contain no executable code

execute_command.description: X110 No ExecuteCommand: Prohibits the use of ExecuteCommand() (disabled for security reasons)

function_version_compatibility.description: C510 Function Version Compatibility: Reports TurboIntegrator functions incompatible with a target Planning Analytics / TM1 version (v11, v12, or both)

hardcoded_secret.description: X130 No Hardcoded Secrets: Reports variables whose name looks like a credential being fed from a hardcoded string literal or read out of a cube

indentation.description: F310 Block Indentation: Enforces indentation for IF/WHILE blocks and wrapped lines

item_skip.description: C130 ItemSkip Block Usage: Enforces that ItemSkip() is only used in metadata or data sections (deprecated, superseded by C150)

keyword_casing.description: F110 Keyword Casing: Enforces consistent keyword casing (uppercase/lowercase/camelcase/consistent)

max_line_length.description: F330 Maximum Line Length: Limits how long a physical line may be

misplaced_function.description: C150 Misplaced Function: Detects TI functions used in invalid or not recommended procedure sections

nesting_depth.description: P900 Maximum Nesting Depth Exceeded: Flags a procedure whose statement or expression nesting exceeded the configured limit, stopping the parser before it could build a full AST for that section

newline_per_statement.description: F320 One Statement Per Line: Enforces that each statement is followed by a newline

odbc_open_parameter.description: X120 ODBCOpen Password Parameter: Validates that ODBCOpen() password parameter is a defined TI parameter

one_space_before_equals.description: Configures the removed Equals Spacing rule. This setting is ignored; remove 'rules.one_space_before_equals' from the config.

parameter_naming.description: N210 Parameter Naming: Enforces that parameters start with lowercase 'p'

process_call_literal.description: C310 Literal Process Calls: Enforces that RunProcess()/ExecuteProcess() use a string literal as first argument

process_quit.description: The 'process_quit' rule was renamed. This setting is ignored; use 'rules.conditional_control_flow' (and 'rules.unreachable_code') instead.

readonly_parameter_variable.description: C210 Read-only Parameters and Variables: Enforces that parameters and data source variables are read-only

sql_where_filtering.description: X210 Filter ODBC Rows in SQL: Flags ItemSkip() or exclusively conditional writes in Metadata/Data when the ODBC data source query has no WHERE clause

unknown_statement.description: P110 Unparseable Statement: Flags statements that could not be parsed, warning that linting quality is reduced for that code

unreachable_code.description: C140 Unreachable Code: Flags code after a flow-terminating statement that can never execute

use_hierarchy_aware_functions.description: C410 Use Hierarchy-Aware Functions: Enforces hierarchy-aware functions, or at least consistent usage of hierarchy-aware vs. standard hierarchy functions

variable_consistent_casing.description: N120 Variables Consistent Casing: Enforces consistent casing for variable references within a process

variable_naming.description: N220 Data Source Variable Naming: Enforces that data source variables start with lowercase 'v'

variable_prefix.description: N110 Variable Prefix Naming: Enforces TM1 variable naming conventions (n/s/c prefixes)

whitespace.description:
F220 Whitespace Around Operators: Enforces exactly one space around binary operators
F230 Whitespace After Comma: Enforces exactly one space after commas
F240 No Space Before Semicolon: Enforces no whitespace immediately before ';'
F250 One Space Inside Parentheses: Enforces exactly one space inside '(' and ')'
F260 No Multiple Spaces: Enforces no multiple consecutive spaces (except indentation)
F270 No Trailing Whitespace: Enforces no trailing whitespace at the end of lines

Severity.description: How much weight a finding carries.
